description: For nonempty candidate sets, an inclusion-maximal partial selection graph is total and is exactly the graph of a choice function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ChoicePrinciples.maximal_partial_selection_total.{u} {ι α : Type u} (A : ι → Set α)
  (hne : ∀ (i : ι), (A i).Nonempty) (G : Set (ι × α))
  (hG : Maximal (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ChoicePrinciples.PartialSelection A) G) :
  (∀ (i : ι), ∃ a, (i, a) ∈ G) ∧ ∃ c, (∀ (i : ι), c i ∈ A i) ∧ G = {p | p.2 = c p.1}
